{{Quote|That's a male, you know. The lamproid. I killed and mounted the male. I sedated and captured his mate, and have her locked on the grounds for a later hunt. Perhaps you'd care to join me.|Tyro Viveca, on his next trophy|<ref name="FP" />}}
A '''Lamproid''' was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. In a run-in with the [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] big-game [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Tyro Viveca/Legends|Tyro Viveca]], her [[Unidentified Lamproid (Tyro Viveca's trophy)|mate]] was killed and she was captured, placed in a [[force cage]], and sedated so that Viveca could hunt her down on a later date.<ref name="FP" />

During her captivity, the [[Gender/Legends|female]] Lamproid had little room and no freedom, and was left with no choice but to wallow in her own filth. She attempted to escape, but the force cage shocked and stunned her each time she slammed her weight against it, leaving her body scarred and burned. When an unknown [[Human/Legends|Human]] approached her cage&mdash;actually the conman [[Cecil Noone]], running from Tyro Viveca himself&mdash;the Lamproid sensed she might manipulate him. She used [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] powers to ease the pain of an injury Noone had suffered and to suggest to Noone that he free her. He dutifully did so, and she escaped into the brush.<ref name="FP" />

The Lamproid later ambushed Viveca as he hunted down Noone with the aid of his hunting [[nashtah]] and [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] servant, [[Rutt]]. She killed Rutt with a stab of her tail stinger, and snapped off the nashtah's leg with her coils. She then attacked the Krish. The two grappled for a moment, and the Lamproid used her telepathy on the hunter. However, Viveca managed to free his [[Hunting blaster/Legends|hunting blaster]], which prompted the Lamproid to retreat and swipe at him with her tail stinger. Nevertheless, the Krish managed to shoot the Lamproid at point-blank range, decapitating her.<ref name="FP" />
